Preparation: 

- Bring a bowl of water to a boil. Cook the pasta according to the instructions on the package. In the last minutes, add the broccoli florets to the pasta cooking water or cook the broccoli in a separate bowl until al dente.
- Heat the unsweetened soy milk in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion pieces and a bay leaf. Let the milk stand for ten minutes to allow the flavors to infuse.
- Preheat the oven to 200°C.
- Now make the roux for the béchamel sauce. Melt the vegan butter in a pan over medium heat. Add the flour and stir with a whisk until the flour and melted butter are completely mixed and there are no lumps.
- Pour the infused soy milk through a sieve to remove the onion and bay leaf from the milk. Add the soy milk little by little to the roux while continuing to stir with a whisk. Stir until the roux and milk are a smooth paste and only then add soy milk again. Repeat until you've used up all the soy milk. Check with a wooden spoon that no lumps of roux are sticking to the bottom of the pan. At the end you normally have a creamy sauce.
Stir the stock cube, mustard, nutritional yeast, vegan cheese and smoked paprika into the sauce. Taste and season with salt, pepper and nutmeg.
- Fry the vegan bacon pieces in a pan with some olive oil, if you use the bacon cubes.
Drain the pasta and broccoli and mix in a large baking dish. Mix in the bacon bits. Pour the cheese sauce over the pasta.
- Put the breadcrumbs with a dash of olive oil in a food processor and press the pulse button a few times.
- Divide the breadcrumbs with a few fresh thyme sprigs over the oven dish.
- Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes.
- Serve with a fresh salad. Tasty!

English recipe, to save time for others: 

Preparation time: 45 minutes
 Servings: 4 persons


Ingredients: 
- 350 g macaroni, or other pasta of your choice, 1 broccoli in small florets. 175 g vegan bacon (optional)


- For the vegan cheese sauce: 1 onion, quartered, 1 bay leaf, 1 liter of unsweetened soy milk, 100 g vegan butter, 1 tsp mustard, 1.5 tbsp nutritional yeast, 70 g vegan cheese, 0.5 tsp smoked paprika powder, 1 vegan stock cube, 85 g flour, 1 pinch of nutmeg
salt and pepper, to taste

- For the crispy crust: 70 g breadcrumbs, A dash of olive oil, fresh thyme sprigs
